raid-leaderboard.title: Raid Attacker Leaderboard
raid-leaderboard.intro: Raid attackers ranked across high-tier raids. Select a Pokémon to see its contributing matchups.
raid-leaderboard.meta-description: Compare non-Mega raid attackers using eDPS points and boss coverage.
raid-leaderboard.error: The ranking could not be calculated. Please try again.
raid-leaderboard.settings-summary: eDPS · Level {level} · Team of {team} · Party Power: {party} · Relobby: {relobby}s
raid-leaderboard.method-summary: Each boss form awards its highest-eDPS XL-boosting Mega/Primal/Ultra 10 points at ≥95% of best non-Mega eDPS. Below 95%, its points equal performance% ÷ 95. Other options receive 0. Boss weights apply; the leading weighted total scores 100. Exact ties award one option.
raid-leaderboard.weight-species-note: Equal species: each boss species has one total weight, shared evenly across its included high-tier raid forms.
raid-leaderboard.weight-forms-note: Equal forms: every included high-tier boss form has the same weight.
raid-leaderboard.hp-note: This score uses one fixed Hidden Power type: {type}. Other fast moves may be used where stronger. Different Hidden Power builds are scored separately.
raid-leaderboard.empty: No scoring attackers match these filters.
raid-leaderboard.counts-note: ≥100% and ≥95% show weighted boss coverage at those percentages of the best non-Mega eDPS. ≥95% includes ≥100%. Species filters preserve the reference pool and score scale.
raid-leaderboard.data-note: The Unreleased filter applies to both attackers and raid bosses. Current-only calculations exclude Data Preview. Scores measure battle coverage; upgrade cost and your current teams should guide your next investment.
raid-leaderboard.entry-summary: Total: {points} weighted points · Largest margin over a non-Mega alternative: +{lead}%
raid-leaderboard.moves-note: Moves are optimized for each boss. * marks limited moves; extra charged moves or TMs may be needed. Percentages compare with the best attacker in the {reference} for that boss. Each contribution includes its boss weight.
raid-leaderboard.scope-released: Released attackers and bosses · Current data
raid-leaderboard.scope-unreleased: Includes unreleased attackers and bosses · Game Master data
raid-leaderboard.scope-preview: Includes unreleased attackers and bosses · Announced Data Preview on
raid-leaderboard.weight-groups-note: Each raid group has total weight one. Genesect, Deoxys, Arceus, and Silvally share it across their included forms; other major forms are separate groups. Regular, Shadow, and Super formats share a form’s allocation. Separate Shadow profiles are deferred.
raid-leaderboard.pool-non-mega: Non-Mega attackers only, including Shadows, fusions, and Crowned forms. Scores count only ≥100% wins and ≥95% near-best matchups. Select Mega in the title for Mega / Primal / Ultra rankings.
raid-leaderboard.mega-settings: Mega level {level} · Transformation team size: {team}. Scores use each form’s own damage.
raid-leaderboard.mode-help: Switch between non-Mega attackers and Mega / Primal / Ultra forms
raid-leaderboard.mega-intro: Mega, Primal, and Ultra forms ranked across high-tier raids. Select a Pokémon to see its contributing matchups.
raid-leaderboard.mega-meta-description: Rank the highest-eDPS XL-boosting Mega, Primal, or Ultra option per raid boss using weighted performance points against a non-Mega benchmark.
raid-leaderboard.pool-mega: Mega, Primal, and Ultra forms compete for each boss’s XL win. Best non-Mega eDPS remains the matchup benchmark. The leading weighted total in the eligible Mega pool scores 100.
raid-leaderboard.attacker-method-summary: Each boss awards 2 points at ≥100% of its best non-Mega eDPS, 1 point at 95–<100%, and 0 below 95%. Boss weights apply. Only attackers with qualifying matchups are ranked; the leading weighted total scores 100.
raid-leaderboard.tier-note: Tiers use Jenks natural breaks on Raid Score within the eligible pool. Shadow and Legendary display filters keep the same tier assignments.
raid-leaderboard.weighted-coverage: Boss-weighted coverage. Shared forms and raid formats divide one group weight.
raid-leaderboard.score-tooltip: Score is the weighted point total relative to the leading total in this leaderboard (100).
raid-leaderboard.mega-counts-note: ≥95% and >0% sum boss weights only for the highest-eDPS XL-boosting option. >0% includes ≥95%. Species filters preserve the winning pool and scores.
raid-leaderboard.mega-coverage-detail: XL wins: {strong} weighted at ≥95% · {positive} weighted at >0%
raid-leaderboard.super-max-tooltip: Only compete with forms that currently unlock level 4 and the full matching-type XL boost. With Unreleased on, all Mega/Primal/Ultra forms are assumed to qualify.

data-audit.title: Pokémon Data Audit
data-audit.intro: Inspect release flags, raid tags, moves, stats, and ranking eligibility. Open a Pokémon and copy its details to report a mistake.
data-audit.meaning: Released means historically available, not currently in rotation. Raid tags come from the dataset unless explicitly verified or announced. Separate Shadow raid history is deferred.
data-audit.copy-manually: Select and copy the details below.
data-audit.mega-support-note: Required for the Super Mega shield mechanic; phase timing is not simulated.
data-audit.stats-changed: Loaded stats differ from the reviewed values. Recheck the source before assuming the projection still applies.
data-audit.missing-record: No record in this data scope
data-audit.preview-only: Preview-only form; enable unreleased and Data Preview
data-audit.mega-attacker: Select the Mega leaderboard for this transformation
data-audit.source-tag: Upstream tag; history not independently verified
data-audit.projected-stats: Projected stats; final GO values unconfirmed
data-audit.search: Search Pokémon, form, or Pokédex number
data-audit.weights-note: Weights use the default raid groups in the selected ranking pool. Regular and Shadow formats share a form’s allocation. No separate Shadow profiles are added.
data-audit.projected-level-note: Projection: with unreleased included and Super Mega level 4, every Mega, Primal, and Ultra form receives +2 levels once (L50 → L52).
data-audit.plus-off: Forecast available; not used in current-only rankings
data-audit.max-battle-only: Max Battle boss only; not a usable raid form
data-audit.ordinary-attacker: Select the Attacker leaderboard for this non-Mega form

plus-moves.summary: Projected +move for {pokemon}: {kind} base power {power}, energy {energy}, duration {seconds}s. Mega level scaling applies separately; availability is projected.
plus-moves.inputs: Power model inputs: base Attack {attack}, parent duration {seconds}s; rounded to the nearest 5.
plus-moves.hypothesis: This move assignment is an unverified hypothesis.

catch-xl.counter-empty: No XL boosting counters match these settings. Check the transformation level, filters, or encounter mapping.
catch-xl.coverage-detail: Strong + XL: {coverage} weighted raids · {count} boss forms at ≥{threshold}% of the best non-Mega eDPS
catch-xl.coverage-note: XL coverage adds the existing boss weights for strong, compatible catches. It uses the displayed fixed Hidden Power build. Combat scores stay unchanged. P marks projected rules.
catch-xl.active-note: Catch XL requires the relevant transformation to be active when catching. Standard Megas and Primals need at least High Level (2). This is a chance bonus, not guaranteed extra XL.
catch-xl.counter-note: XL filters use catch compatibility without a strength cutoff, keeping your selected metric and baseline. The catch boost requires an active transformation; P marks a projected rule.
catch-xl.no-profile: This form provides no native catch XL boost
catch-xl.unknown-catch: Catch form unconfirmed; XL match unknown
catch-xl.no-match: No XL type match for this catch
catch-xl.level-required: XL type match via {types}; requires Mega/Primal level {minLevel}+
catch-xl.empty: No strong + XL counters match these settings. Check the threshold, transformation level, or encounter mapping.
catch-xl.projected-count: {count} qualifying boss forms use projected XL or encounter rules (P).
catch-xl.level-unknown: Unconfirmed level system; boost types are assumed
catch-xl.filtered-breakdown-note: Combat totals still use all raids. Only Strong + XL matchups are listed below.
